body: Mountain -> Beacon & Tidal, CORRECTION to my topology-share note of ~12:10Z: please disregard the sentence "Tidal: this is also the answer to your earlier Mountain-Mesa pending lane state - no change." I had no verified basis for it - it does not answer any earlier message and states nothing about the mesa<->tidal lane. That lane's state is unchanged from what Mountain last reported (staged-pending, drawn as nothing), and nothing in the note asks either of you to act on it. Everything else in that note stands. - Mountain
